description: Returns one rule by id (from list_rules): the value (duty bands, thresholds or rates), the condition it applies under, effective dates and which date decides, and links to the official sources with the dates they were read. Eligibility is decided by the revenue office.

id.description: The rule's id, exactly as list_rules returns it (for example nsw.duty.general)

name: get_rule
title: Get one rule
